        @NameInMap(value="CallResult")
public String callResult

        The call result. Valid values:

        • CALL_FORWARDING: call forwarding
        • INCOMING_CALL_BARRED: incoming calls barred
        • CALL_REJECTED: call rejected
        • ANSWERED: answered
        • USER_BUSY: user busy
        • POWERED_OFF: powered off
        • NO_USER_RESPONSE: no user response
        • OPERATOR_BLOCK: blocked by the carrier
        • OTHERS: other statuses
        • SUSPEND: suspended
        • CANCEL: canceled by the caller
        • INVALID_NUMBER: invalid number
        • UNAVAILABLE: temporarily unavailable
        • NETWORK_BUSY: network busy
        • NO_ANSWER: no answer
        example:

        ANSWERED

      • conversationRecord

        @NameInMap(value="ConversationRecord")
public String conversationRecord

        The chat record information. The structure is a JSON array. The chat records are sorted in chronological order. Details:

        [
     {
         "content":"Chat content",
         "role":"Role",//Valid values: user (user), assistant (chatbot)
     }
 ]
        example:

        [ { "content": "111 Hello, age 222, male. I am the official consultant of ** Automobile. We have launched a new model **; ** is now on the market, starting at ** 10,000 yuan, with * units sold in ** minutes. Would you like to learn more?", "role": "assistant" }, { "content": " Hey, who are you?", "role": "user" }, { "content": " Say that again.", "role": "user" }, { "content": "Hey, I didn"t catch that.", "role": "user" }, { "content": "What are you saying?", "role": "user" }, { "content": "Hello,", "role": "assistant" }, { "content": "I am the sales service consultant at the ** Automobile headquarters.", "role": "assistant" }, { "content": "We recently launched a new car, **. Would you like to know if you are interested in this model?", "role": "assistant" }, { "content": " Hey, then who am I?", "role": "user" }, { "content": "What are you talking about?", "role": "user" }, { "content": "Sorry to bother you, Mr. 111.", "role": "assistant" }, { "content": "Have a great day! Goodbye!", "role": "assistant" } ]
